contents: Postwar rebuilding, 1960. Wide high-angle views over a large new estate of identical tile-roofed rehousing homes below the mountains, then a single new house with a corn and vegetable garden. After the cut: a small corner shop with bicycles out front and a boy running past, and a smiling shopkeeper behind a glass counter with a hanging scale. Ends on a laundry-hung alley. The shop shots are overexposed in the source. 1080p scan; silent.
